MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; 1W sector breadth is 64%, indicating Internal Rotation, while Technology and Energy are negative and risk/cycle signals are unavailable. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication); this concentration and mixed sector performance argue against a stronger regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads at +5.62% for the week and +7.47% for the month; CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%) and TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%) are ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary is next, with LOW (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +25.74%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare is also strong, with LLY (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +21.11%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy is weakest at -6.52% for the week and -6.55% for the month; XOM (1W: -7.32% | 1M: -4.46%) and PSX (1W: -7.81% | 1M: -10.93%) are BELOW TREND. Technology is also weak at -1.94% for the week and -10.94% for the month, with NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%) and NOW (1W: -8.75% | 1M: -29.01%) BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top five: CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%), TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%), NEM (1W: +11.62% | 1M: +2.40%), TMUS (1W: +9.50% | 1M: +11.33%), and LOW (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +25.74%) are all ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication), a concentration caution.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom five: NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%), VLO (1W: -9.53% | 1M: -19.56%), ETN (1W: -9.29% | 1M: -16.73%), MPC (1W: -8.84% | 1M: -15.10%), and NOW (1W: -8.75% | 1M: -29.01%) are all BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology, Energy and Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves include CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%), TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%) and NEM (1W: +11.62% | 1M: +2.40%), all ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: MSFT (1W: +2.34% | 1M: -1.48%), GOOGL (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -18.52%) and META (1W: +3.28% | 1M: -13.67%) are RECOVERY; watch for trend break rather than treating the bounce as confirmation.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak sector trend: aggregate returns are -1.94% for 1W and -10.94% for 1M; positive-stock breadth within the sector was not provided. NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%) is BELOW TREND, while MSFT (1W: +2.34% | 1M: -1.48%), GOOGL (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -18.52%) and META (1W: +3.28% | 1M: -13.67%) are RECOVERY.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are positive on average, +1.10% for 1W and +3.33% for 1M; positive-stock breadth within the sector was not provided. JPM (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +2.32%), V (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +8.87%) and MA (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +10.71%) are ABOVE TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is firm at +1.88% for 1W and +8.88% for 1M; positive-stock breadth within the sector was not provided. JNJ (1W: +5.49% | 1M: +6.46%), UNH (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +7.03%) and LLY (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +21.11%) are ABOVE TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor select areas of relative strength, including Communication, Consumer Discretionary and Financials, while reducing exposure to weak Technology and Energy names. Style mixed / no clear leadership: sector returns and the concentrated top performers do not confirm a broad Growth- or Value-style lead.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%), ABOVE TREND, for follow-through on strong pre-order news; confirmation would support the move. BEARISH: Watch NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%), BELOW TREND, for continued downside, and monitor UNH (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +7.03%), ABOVE TREND, for any price response to negative plan-exit news.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication, +5.62% for 1W and +7.47% for 1M, has the strongest aggregate momentum; breadth within the sector was not supplied. BEARISH: Energy, -6.52% for 1W and -6.55% for 1M, is weakest, while Technology is also under pressure at -1.94% for 1W and -10.94% for 1M.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Numeric support and resistance levels were not supplied. Watch whether NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%), BELOW TREND, stabilizes; whether AAPL (1W: +5.00% | 1M: +2.21%), ABOVE TREND, holds its upward trend; and whether JPM (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +2.32%), ABOVE TREND, maintains positive momentum.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
TTWO (+55): GTA VI pre-orders reportedly track well above plan; TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%) is ABOVE TREND, confirming the positive catalyst. TSLA (+60): Finland approved its assisted-driving system, but TSLA (1W: -4.70% | 1M: +0.46%) is in CORRECTION, so price action does not yet confirm the positive headline.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-50): Medicare plan exits in 140 counties; UNH (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +7.03%) is ABOVE TREND, a sentiment/price divergence to monitor. BA (-35): October deliveries declined; BA (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -8.51%) is in RECOVERY, also diverging from the negative headline, while AMZN (-25) faces an Italian VAT-related report as AMZN (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +4.37%) remains ABOVE TREND.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, with breadth at 7/11 sectors positive, Internal Rotation and narrow leadership (3/5 Communication); style mixed / no clear leadership. CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%) and TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%) are ABOVE TREND, while JPM (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +2.32%) is also ABOVE TREND. Major divergence persists as MSFT (1W: +2.34% | 1M: -1.48%), GOOGL (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -18.52%) and META (1W: +3.28% | 1M: -13.67%) recover on the week despite negative monthly returns; monitor for trend confirmation.
